d.ko: You are a traveling painter, exploring the island of Eastshade. Capture the world on canvas using your artist’s easel. Talk to the inhabitants to learn about their lives. Make friends and help those in need. Visit cities, scale summits, unearth mysteries, and discover forgotten places!

d.zh: 你是一位旅行画家，正在探索东方之茵的奥秘。使用画架和画布捕捉世界。与原住民交流，了解他们的生活。结交朋友，帮助有需要的人。参观都市、攀登高峰、揭开未解之迷，探索被遗忘的地方！
